rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a physically comfortable, cosy way.

example.english: On my days off, I like to watch movies comfortably at home.
example.traditional: 我放假鍾意喺屋企舒舒服服咁睇戲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gaa3 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 syu1 syu1 fuk6 fuk6 gam3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when something is done easily or without difficulty, rather than to describe physical comfort.

example.traditional: 佢哋輕輕鬆鬆咁做完呢份功課喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hing1 hing1 sung1 sung1 gam3 zou6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 laa3
